jobs.title: Job matches
jobs.disclaimer: Listings are published by labour offices on ShramSetu. ShramSetu does not verify the employer or the wage. Never pay a fee to get a job.

jobs.unverifiedNote: ShramSetu has not verified this employer or the wage. Confirm the terms in writing before starting work.
jobs.shortlistedNote: The office read your application. This is not an offer of work — keep applying.

review.panelSubtitle: Publish work inside your jurisdiction, then review the workers who apply.
review.unverifiedNote: Listings are scoped to your jurisdiction and marked unverified for workers: ShramSetu cannot confirm that an employer will honour the stated wage.
review.loadError: Could not load your job listings.
review.outsideJurisdiction: That listing is outside your jurisdiction.
review.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Mason required for apartment site
review.descriptionPlaceholder: Work, site, wage payment schedule, working hours
review.employerPlaceholder: Name as workers will see it
review.contactPlaceholder: Leave blank if unknown — workers will be told to apply through the portal
review.noListingsHint: Create a listing to start receiving applications from workers in your district.
review.fitNote: Fit compares only the trade, district and state the worker entered on their profile. It is not a rating of the worker — read the application before deciding.
review.phoneNotShared: Phone not shared — contact them through this office
review.shortlistNote: Shortlisting only records that this office read the application. It is not an offer of work.
